# Orbit Runner

Control a satellite orbiting a planet on an HTML canvas. Use the left/right arrows to apply thrust and change the orbital radius. Randomly spawning asteroids move radially; avoid them. Lose if you collide with an asteroid or crash into the planet. Score is measured by survival time.

<content>
1: // Orbit Runner – simple canvas game
2: // Canvas with id="game" must exist in the page.
3: (() => {
4:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
5:   if (!canvas) return;
6:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
7:   // Set canvas size to its CSS size or fallback
8:   const W = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
9:   const H = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600;
10:   // Generate simple starfield background
11:   const STAR_COUNT = 100;
12:   const stars = Array.from({ length: STAR_COUNT }, () => ({
13:     x: Math.random() * W,
14:     y: Math.random() * H,
15:     radius: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5,
16:     opacity: Math.random() * 0.6 + 0.4,
17:   }));
18: 
19:   // Trail for satellite (stores last positions)
20:   const trail = [];
21:   const TRAIL_MAX = 30;
22: 
23:   // ----- Game constants -----
24:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
25:   function playTone(freq, dur) {
26:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
27:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
28:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
29:     osc.connect(gain);
30:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
31:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.1, audioCtx.currentTime);
32:     osc.start();
33:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + dur);
34:   }
35:   let lastThrustSound = 0;
36:   const PLANET_RADIUS = 40;
37:   const SAT_RADIUS = 8;
38:   const ASTEROID_RADIUS = 12;
39:   const GRAVITY = 0.001; // pulls satellite toward planet
40:   const THRUST = 0.004; // radial thrust per frame when arrow pressed
41:   const ASTEROID_SPEED = 0.6; // radial speed of asteroids
42:   const ASTEROID_SPAWN_INTERVAL = 2000; // ms
43: 
44:   // ----- Game state -----
45:   let satAngle = 0; // radians
46:   let satRadius = 150; // distance from planet centre
47:   let satRadialVel = 0; // radial velocity
48:   const asteroids = [];
49:   let lastAsteroid = 0;
50:   let startTime = performance.now();
51:   let score = 0;
52:   let running = true;
53:   let gameOverPlayed = false;
54: 
55:   // ----- Input -----
56:   const keys = { ArrowLeft: false, ArrowRight: false };
57:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => { if (e.key in keys) keys[e.key] = true; if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume(); });
58:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => { if (e.key in keys) keys[e.key] = false; });
59:   // also resume on click/touch
60:   window.addEventListener('click', () => { if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume(); });
61: 
62:   // ----- Helper functions -----
63:   function spawnAsteroid() {
64:     const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
65:     const radius = Math.random() * (Math.min(W, H) / 2 - PLANET_RADIUS - 20) + PLANET_RADIUS + 20;
66:     const direction = Math.random() < 0.5 ? -1 : 1; // inward or outward
67:     asteroids.push({ angle, radius, direction });
68:   }
69: 
70:   function update(dt) {
71:     // thrust changes radial velocity
72:     if (keys.ArrowLeft) {
73:       satRadialVel -= THRUST * dt;
74:       const now = performance.now();
75:       if (now - lastThrustSound > 80) { // throttle
76:         playTone(440, 0.05);
77:         lastThrustSound = now;
78:       }
79:     }
80:     if (keys.ArrowRight) {
81:       satRadialVel += THRUST * dt;
82:       const now = performance.now();
83:       if (now - lastThrustSound > 80) {
84:         playTone(660, 0.05);
85:         lastThrustSound = now;
86:       }
87:     }
88:     // gravity pulls inward
89:     satRadialVel -= GRAVITY * dt;
90:     // apply radial velocity
91:     satRadius += satRadialVel * dt;
92:     // keep angle moving (simple orbital angular speed based on radius)
93:     const angularSpeed = 0.001 / Math.max(satRadius, 1);
94:     satAngle += angularSpeed * dt;
95:     // planet collision
96:     if (satRadius <= PLANET_RADIUS + SAT_RADIUS) running = false;
97:     // asteroid spawn
98:     if (performance.now() - lastAsteroid > ASTEROID_SPAWN_INTERVAL) {
99:       spawnAsteroid();
100:       lastAsteroid = performance.now();
101:     }
102:     // update asteroids
103:     for (const a of asteroids) {
104:       a.radius += a.direction * ASTEROID_SPEED * dt;
105:     }
106:     // collision detection
107:     for (const a of asteroids) {
108:       const dx = (satRadius * Math.cos(satAngle) - a.radius * Math.cos(a.angle));
109:       const dy = (satRadius * Math.sin(satAngle) - a.radius * Math.sin(a.angle));
110:       if (Math.hypot(dx, dy) < SAT_RADIUS + ASTEROID_RADIUS) {
111:         running = false;
112:         break;
113:       }
114:     }
115:     // remove off‑screen asteroids
116:     asteroids.splice(0, asteroids.length, ...asteroids.filter(a => a.radius > PLANET_RADIUS && a.radius < Math.min(W, H) / 2));
117:     // score
118:     score = ((performance.now() - startTime) / 1000).toFixed(1);
119:   }
120: 
121: function draw() {
122:     // background black with starfield
123:     ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
124:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
125:     for (const s of stars) {
126:       ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${s.opacity})`;
127:       ctx.beginPath();
128:       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
129:       ctx.fill();
130:     }
131:     // planet with radial gradient (already set in init)
132:     const planetGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(W / 2, H / 2, PLANET_RADIUS * 0.3, W / 2, H / 2, PLANET_RADIUS);
133:     planetGrad.addColorStop(0, '#9c7fb6');
134:     planetGrad.addColorStop(1, '#3b2c4f');
135:     ctx.fillStyle = planetGrad;
136:     ctx.beginPath();
137:     ctx.arc(W / 2, H / 2, PLANET_RADIUS, 0, Math.PI * 2);
138:     ctx.fill();
139:     // satellite position
140:     const satX = W / 2 + satRadius * Math.cos(satAngle);
141:     const satY = H / 2 + satRadius * Math.sin(satAngle);
142:     // add to trail
143:     trail.push({x: satX, y: satY});
144:     if (trail.length > TRAIL_MAX) trail.shift();
145:     // draw trail (fading)
146:     for (let i = 0; i < trail.length; i++) {
147:       const p = trail[i];
148:       const alpha = i / trail.length;
149:       ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,221,87,${alpha * 0.5})`;
150:       ctx.beginPath();
151:       ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, SAT_RADIUS, 0, Math.PI * 2);
152:       ctx.fill();
153:     }
154:     // satellite glow
155:     ctx.shadowBlur = 12;
156:     ctx.shadowColor = '#ffdd57';
157:     ctx.fillStyle = '#ffdd57';
158:     ctx.beginPath();
159:     ctx.arc(satX, satY, SAT_RADIUS, 0, Math.PI * 2);
160:     ctx.fill();
161:     ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
162:     // asteroids with subtle gradient
163:     for (const a of asteroids) {
164:       const x = W / 2 + a.radius * Math.cos(a.angle);
165:       const y = H / 2 + a.radius * Math.sin(a.angle);
166:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(x, y, ASTEROID_RADIUS * 0.2, x, y, ASTEROID_RADIUS);
167:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#b0b0b0');
168:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#555');
169:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
170:       ctx.beginPath();
171:       ctx.arc(x, y, ASTEROID_RADIUS, 0, Math.PI * 2);
172:       ctx.fill();
173:  
174:     // score
175:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
176:     ctx.font = '16px monospace';
177:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}s`, 10, 20);
178:   }
179: 
180:   function loop(timestamp) {
181:     if (!running) {
182:       if (!gameOverPlayed) {
183:         playTone(220, 0.6);
184:         gameOverPlayed = true;
185:       }
186:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
187:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
188:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
189:       ctx.font = '24px monospace';
190:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', W / 2 - 60, H / 2);
191:       ctx.fillText(`Final Score: ${score}s`, W / 2 - 70, H / 2 + 30);
192:       return;
193:     }
194:     const dt = timestamp - (lastRender || timestamp);
195:     lastRender = timestamp;
196:     update(dt);
197:     draw();
198:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
199:   }
200:   let lastRender = 0;
201:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
202: })();

(End of file - total 202 lines)
</content>
